title: Magic Tower Classic
description: Plan every step through a multi-floor fantasy dungeon tower—collect colored keys, drink ruby potions, upgrade your blade, and calculate every monster duel.
controls: Use the on-screen directional pad or arrow/WASD keys to move, unlock color-coded doors, collect treasures, and battle monsters.

zh-CN.title: 魔塔经典版
zh-CN.description: 经典数值策略地牢爬塔：精打细算每把红黄蓝钥匙、每一瓶血药与攻防宝石，步步为营挑战层层强敌。
zh-CN.controls: 使用屏幕方向键或键盘方向键移动角色，拾取钥匙与装备，贴近怪物自动展开回合战斗。
